# Haggai and God’s House (Haggai 1:4)

## Emotional Focus
Putting God first in our everyday work.

## Key KJV
“Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?” (Haggai 1:4)

## Gentle Retelling (3–8)
The people were busy with their own houses, but Haggai reminded them to finish God’s house first. When they did, God blessed them.
